fusions.name: Hedgerow Ambush
fusions.desc: You pounce up to 5 tiles to the target. The pounce deals 14 damage and leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Batting Claws
fusions.desc: A flick that deals 3 damage, leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds and makes it 15% slower for 1.5 seconds.

fusions.name: Low Through the Grass
fusions.desc: Veils you for 6 seconds. Enemies notice you far later, and the veil breaks the moment you attack. Your movement speed rises 25% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Stalk, Then Spring
fusions.desc: Every few paces you cover, your critical chance rises by 20% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. You also have 25% more critical chance against a target that has not been hurt yet.
